principle.name: BRAKING LATERAL MOMENTUM REQUIRES A SUPPORT MOMENT ARM, NOT A FOOT TELEPORT
principle.summary: A fast lateral body cannot become stable by dropping a foot directly under its current COM. A wide outside probe earns the first braking support; the pelvis then passes that support, forcing counterlean and a crossing second catch. Recovery keeps the crossover debt visible through a smaller rebound, overshoot, countercatch, and displaced ready stance.
principle.novelty: first fresh locomotion specimen centered on deliberate lateral momentum bleed through successive outside/cross-step support moment arms; unlike curvature reversal it does not trace a changing path, unlike rolling-support migration the support domain remains feet, and unlike load-release overrun the initiating problem is lateral braking rather than sudden resistance loss.

keys.name: RIGHTWARD_ENTRY_LEFT_OWNS
keys.causal_role: left support owns a fast lateral entry; torso leans into travel while free side remains open
keys.motion_arc_root_note: establish rightward momentum with asymmetrical support

keys.name: RIGHT_OUTSIDE_PROBE
keys.causal_role: left support keeps driving while right foot reaches far outside the COM without yet owning it
keys.motion_arc_root_note: wide probe creates future braking moment arm

keys.name: RIGHT_OUTSIDE_CATCH
keys.causal_role: right outside foot becomes trustworthy while pelvis is still three columns behind it; support begins braking before root arrival
keys.motion_arc_root_note: outside catch / COM remains behind fixed support

keys.name: PELVIS_PASSES_RIGHT_SUPPORT
keys.causal_role: pelvis passes three columns beyond the world-locked right foot; torso counterleans while left leg crosses through as the next probe
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support moment arm flips lean while travel continues

keys.name: LEFT_CROSS_PROBE
keys.causal_role: right support continues braking as the left foot crosses beyond the root to prepare a second catch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: cross-step commits before old support releases

keys.name: LEFT_CROSS_CATCH_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: left cross-step accepts ownership; pelvis drops and torso counterleans against remaining lateral momentum
keys.motion_arc_root_note: second catch converts drift into vertical compression

keys.name: LEFT_BRAKE_HOLD
keys.causal_role: left support holds while the right foot untangles and probes under the slowing COM
keys.motion_arc_root_note: brake dwell makes deceleration readable without freezing the body

keys.name: RIGHT_RECOVERY_PROBE
keys.causal_role: left support releases some stored compression into a short right-foot recovery probe
keys.motion_arc_root_note: rebound is smaller than entry travel and does not reset phase

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH_LATERAL_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: right catch owns the small rebound but upper body overshoots past the new base
keys.motion_arc_root_note: secondary mass keeps traveling after root speed is nearly spent

keys.name: RIGHT_SUPPORT_LEFT_COUNTERPROBE
keys.causal_role: right support stabilizes the displaced address while left foot probes back across the COM
keys.motion_arc_root_note: counterprobe pays crossover debt rather than matching prior stride

keys.name: LEFT_COUNTERCATCH
keys.causal_role: left countercatch creates the only authored root-direction reversal and prevents the overshoot from becoming a drift loop
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support change causes a tiny countertravel instead of reverse interpolation

keys.name: LEFT_SETTLE_RIGHT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: left support settles while the right foot reopens a forward-ready stance

keys.name: RIGHT_DISPLACED_READY
keys.causal_role: right foot becomes the final trusted support with unequal feet and a residual lateral bias
keys.motion_arc_root_note: finish is task-ready at a displaced address, not the entry pose

compile.connective_motion: NONE_BEYOND_AUTHORED_KEYS; every support/root reversal and causal transition is an authored decisive key

history.defect: The first right-foot brake was present, but K02→K03 let the pelvis pass only about one column beyond the support, so the core support-moment-arm reversal read too weakly and risked becoming metadata.
history.correction: Mutate SAME Locomotion017 K02–K04: hold the right support world-locked at x=31, establish the catch with pelvis visibly behind it, then drive pelvis/chest/head three columns beyond it before the left cross probe; sharpen counterlean and preserve nonuniform spacing.

history.basis: Fresh inspection of the actual 33-frame final render: K01 opens a wide right probe; K02 catches with pelvis clearly behind the fixed right foot; K03 carries pelvis/chest/head beyond that world-locked support while counterlean flips; K04 crosses the left probe before old support releases; K05 compresses into the left catch; K06 holds the brake; K07-K09 rebound with smaller spacing and secondary upper-body lag; K10's left countercatch is the only authored root-direction reversal; K11-K12 settle at a displaced asymmetric ready. No support teleport, equal spacing, straight root tween, phase reset, reverse-playback recovery, or idle reset survives.

noodle_queen.basis: The wide outside probe, pelvis-over-support pass, ugly crossed catch, deep counterlean compression, small rebound, upper-body overshoot and tiny support-caused countercatch form a specific lateral-braking sentence. The mechanism is visible in silhouette/support relation rather than living only in labels, and the finish keeps displaced crossover debt.
